as_told.title: Catherine Austin Fitts: trillions embedded in the black budget

plain: This story is about money. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says a woman named Catherine Austin Fitts talks about trillions of dollars missing from the budget of the Department of Defense, the US military, going to secret projects. A guest who goes by UAPGerb puts a figure on it, saying Fitts speaks of 17 to 21 trillion dollars hidden in secret military spending since the 1990s. If true, it would mean there is a vast hidden pot of money that could pay for programmes the public never hears about.
